purpose: Quantify the actual frog and rainfall data volume underlying the current NAAMP manuscript without changing any scientific endpoint.

raw: unique RunID x StopNumber x Species positive cells
eligible_2001_2015: runs passing the exact current ecological-pulse run filter
positive call rows and unique positive taxon-stop cells
potential taxon x stop x run cells
matched_pair_use: unique RunIDs used by those pairs
positive call cells in unique paired runs

rain_volume.naamp_days_since_rain: one run-level value per eligible run

report: hourly precipitation values sampled = weather_runs x 72

boundaries: Potential taxon x stop x run cells are matrix opportunities, not raw CSV rows.
Counts.csv records positive detections/CallingIndex records and is not a dense zero-filled species matrix.
ERA5 hourly-value count is the number of run-hour samples used to construct 72-h totals, not the number of unique grid-time cells after deduplication.
This audit changes no analysis, endpoint, model, sample filter or manuscript claim.
